issue_context.title: ENH: consistency of input args for boundaries
issue_context.body:
There are some methods where boundary inputs are required.

This issue proposes standardising to the keyword arg: `inclusive` and using values `{"both", "neither", "left", "right"}`.

- [x] Styler.highlight_between():  `'inclusive' in {"both", "neither", "left", "right"}` 
- [x] Series.between() (#40628): `'inclusive' in {"both", "neither", "left", "right"}` 
- [x] pd.date_range() https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/43504
- [x] DataFrame.between_time() https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/43248
- [ ] pd.Interval https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/46522
- [ ] pd.interval_range https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/46355
- [ ] pd.IntervalIndex https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/46522
- [ ] pd.cut
- [ ] Series.resample
- [ ] DataFrame.rolling(closed)

More methods yet to be identified.
